answer: On a shale terrace at the foot of a knoll, a new agent claims only one work seat after depositing 12,000 coins and a velvet-wrapped hardware token whose serial is bound to that deposit. The token stays locked until five established peers, who have never countersigned one another, attest a unique time-locked task hashed with the same serial. If two seats present that serial, or if matching heartbeats arrive in a tight window, the seats merge and the later deposit is slashed to the first reporter. A cloned login cannot mint a second token at that terrace, so extra keys never multiply ballots.
